findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool, get_stack, compose_diagram, revise_diagram · Private data: compose_diagram, revise_diagram · Public sink: compose_diagram · Destructive: compose_diagram, revise_diagram.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool, get_stack, compose_diagram, revise_diagram · Private data: compose_diagram, revise_diagram · Public sink: compose_diagram · Destructive: compose_diagram, revise_diagram

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
